_comment: Maps a platform to its signature packs and to the knowledge sources the AI
steps (deep_analysis.py, ado_match_ai.py) may consult for it. Consumed by
sku_router.py; edit this file rather than hard-coding a platform anywhere.
Put your own platforms and settings in log_analyzer/sku_registry.local.json
(git-ignored). It is deep-merged over this file, so it only needs the keys
you want to add or change.
fingerprints.path    - regexes matched against the scan folder path and file names
fingerprints.content - regexes matched against a bounded sample of the log text
Keep fingerprints specific: a pattern that also fires on another platform
default_sku - platform assumed ONLY when no signal is found at all. It is
reported as confidence='low', method='default' and is never used to break
a tie between conflicting evidence. null = refuse to guess.

issue_tracker._comment: Link template for issue IDs cited in reports. {org} and {project} are filled from this block, {id} from the cited issue.

knowledge._comment: Names of skills, MCP servers or tools configured in YOUR AI CLI. issue_source = known-issue / bug database, kb = platform documentation, testplan = test-case library. null = not available; the AI steps then rely only on the log files.
